steps.text: ars-zero: the circlet carries the SPELL_CASTER component from its own item properties, so a given stack is castable and Item.use reaches AbstractMultiPhaseCastDevice.openDeviceGUI, which setScreens the device GUI on the client

ars-zero: nothing is focused on open; AbstractMultiPhaseCastDeviceScreen.charTyped takes the first character into the search bar and focuses it after a 30 ms open guard, so the bar ends up holding the whole query and the later characters go through the screen route into it

ars-zero: the bar is nuggets' CopyEditBox, not an EditBox, so assert_focus_text names it instead of reading it; onSearchChanged compares each known glyph's locale name with the typed text (localeName.toLowerCase().contains(text.toLowerCase()))
